modules.name: main
modules.description: Application entry point. Sets version and delegates to cmd.Execute() for CLI handling.
modules.interfaces: Receives Version from build flags, calls cmd.SetVersion() and cmd.Execute(). Exit on error.

modules.name: cmd
modules.description: CLI command layer using Cobra framework. Defines three commands: watch (default), scan, and mcp. Handles configuration loading, directory initialization, and orchestrates analyzer/mcp packages.
modules.interfaces: Execute() runs the root command. SetVersion(v) sets version. Exports Config types for YAML parsing.

submodules.name: root
submodules.description: Root command definition with global flags (--path, --log-level, --version)

submodules.name: watch
submodules.description: Watch mode - monitors file changes continuously, updates index on change
submodules.interfaces: watchCmd with --config, --skip-scan flags. Calls analyzer.NewWatcher, analyzer.NewAnalyser

submodules.name: scan
submodules.description: Scan mode - analyzes all files once, updates index, then exits
submodules.interfaces: scanCmd with --config flag. Same flow as watch but exits after Flush()

submodules.name: mcp
submodules.description: MCP mode - starts stdio JSON-RPC server for AI agents to query index
submodules.interfaces: mcpCmd. Validates index exists, calls mcp.Serve(workDir)

submodules.name: config
submodules.description: Configuration types and loading from YAML file with defaults

submodules.name: common
submodules.description: Shared utilities: index initialization, config setup
submodules.interfaces: initIndex(indexDir) creates .memo/index/*.json, mcp.json, .gitignore. loadConfigAndSetup() loads config and sets log level

internal.relationships: root → watch/scan/mcp commands → config + common utilities

modules.name: analyzer
modules.description: Core analysis engine. Watches filesystem with fsnotify, invokes AI via kimi-agent-sdk, validates JSON output against schemas. Includes status management, locking, and startup banner.
modules.interfaces: NewAnalyser(AgentConfig, workDir), Analyse(ctx, files). NewWatcher(root, ignore, debounce, maxWait, onChange), ScanAll(), Flush(), Run(), Close(). ValidateIndex(indexDir). TryLock/Unlock. SetStatus/GetStatus. PrintBanner(opts).

submodules.name: analyser
submodules.description: AI-powered analysis using kimi-agent-sdk. Batches files, sends prompts, validates output with retry loop (max 5 attempts).
submodules.interfaces: NewAnalyser(), Analyse(ctx, files), analyseBatch(), runPrompt(). Uses embedded prompts/*.md

submodules.name: watcher
submodules.description: Filesystem watcher using fsnotify. Debounce/max-wait batching, concurrent analysis guard via semaphore.
submodules.interfaces: NewWatcher(), ScanAll(), Flush(), Run(), Close(), add(), ignored()

submodules.name: validator
submodules.description: JSON schema validation for .memo/index files using gojsonschema

submodules.name: lock
submodules.description: Single-instance lock using flock (Unix) or LockFileEx (Windows)

submodules.name: banner
submodules.description: Startup banner with ASCII art, version, greeting, update notice. Adapts to terminal width.

internal.relationships: analyser uses watcher for file events, validator for output checking, status for progress tracking. lock ensures single instance. banner for UX.

modules.name: mcp
modules.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Exposes .memo/index via JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. Tools: memo_list_keys, memo_get_value with bracket-notation path parsing.
modules.interfaces: Serve(workDir) starts server. NewServer(workDir), Run(), Close(). ListKeys(indexDir, path), GetValue(indexDir, path). ParsePath(path) parses [file][key][index] notation.

submodules.name: server
submodules.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 server handling initialize, tools/list, tools/call methods. Logs to .memo/.history.
submodules.interfaces: NewServer(), Run(), handleRequest(), handleToolCall(), tools() returns tool definitions with whenToUse guidance

submodules.name: query
submodules.description: Path parser and query executor. State machine for bracket notation, validates against allowed files.
submodules.interfaces: ParsePath(path) → file, segments, err. ListKeys(), GetValue(). traverse() navigates JSON. validateKey() security check.

internal.relationships: server → query for tool calls. server reads status.json to add stale-data warnings.

modules.name: internal
modules.description: Shared utilities package. Logging with levels, LineBuffer for streaming output, HistoryLogger for debugging, auto-update checker.
modules.interfaces: SetLogLevel(), LogError/LogNotice/LogInfo/LogDebug(). NewLineBuffer(timeout), Write(), Flush(). NewHistoryLogger(), Log(), LogError/Info/Debug(), Close(). CheckUpdate(version), CheckUpdateAsync(version).

submodules.name: log
submodules.description: Logging with 4 levels (error/notice/info/debug). Global historyLog integration. LineBuffer for clean streaming output.
submodules.interfaces: SetLogLevel(), Log*() functions. InitHistoryLogger(), CloseHistoryLogger(). NewLineBuffer(), Write(), Flush(force)

submodules.name: history
submodules.description: HistoryLogger writes JSONL to .memo/.history for debugging. Thread-safe with sequence numbers.

submodules.name: updater
submodules.description: Auto-update checker via GitHub API. Async check with 2s timeout, semver comparison.
submodules.interfaces: CheckUpdate(currentVersion), CheckUpdateAsync(version). UpdateInfo struct with LatestVersion, UpdateCommand

internal.relationships: log uses history for persistent logging. updater is standalone.

## Module Dependencies

```mermaid
graph TD
  main --> cmd
  cmd --> analyzer
  cmd --> mcp
  cmd --> internal
  analyzer --> internal
  mcp --> internal
  analyzer --> kimi-agent-sdk
  analyzer --> fsnotify
  analyzer --> gojsonschema
  mcp --> .memo/index
```

## Data Flow

1. **Watch/Scan mode**: cmd/watch.go or cmd/scan.go → analyzer.Watcher → analyzer.Analyser → kimi-agent-sdk → .memo/index/*.json
2. **MCP mode**: cmd/mcp.go → mcp.Server → mcp.query → .memo/index/*.json

## Directory Structure

- `cmd/` - CLI commands (watch, scan, mcp)
- `analyzer/` - Core analysis logic
- `mcp/` - MCP server
- `internal/` - Shared utilities
- `analyzer/prompts/` - Embedded AI prompt templates
- `tests/` - Test files organized by package
